basic_details.job_title: SACON Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

Duration is one year (likely to be extended), and pay runs from Rs. 30,000 + HRA to Rs. 42,000 + HRA a month depending on the post and NET/GATE status. content_sections.heading: About SACON
content_sections.text: SACON is the South India Centre of the Wildlife Institute of India, located at Moongilpallam, Anaikatty (PO), Coimbatore – 641 108, Tamil Nadu. The notice is issued by the Nodal Officer, Recruitment and Placement Cell, WII-SACON. These posts are in SACON's own research projects and are a government institute's temporary project engagements, not regular posts.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: SACON has printed one position each for three of the posts and two for Project Associate-I in Project 3, which makes 5 positions in total. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. Candidates must hold all the essential qualifications, with originals of supporting documents, as on the date of the application deadline. The upper age limit for every post is 35 years as on 07-12-2026. Accepted disciplines as printed. Project Associate-I (1(a)): Zoology, Wildlife Biology, Wildlife Science, Forestry, Conservation Biology, Biodiversity Studies, Ecological Sciences, Environmental Studies or any other allied disciplines. Project Associate-I (3(b)) and Project Associate-II (3(a)): the same list, with "any allied disciplines" for 3(b). Project Associate-II (Molecular Biology): Zoology, Wildlife Science, Forestry, Conservation Biology, Biodiversity Studies, Ecological Sciences, Environmental Studies, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Microbiology or any other allied disciplines. Interest in bird research and conservation. Skill and experience in bird surveys and field ecology methods. Willingness to reside in remote locations with challenging conditions and travel extensively by road and sea between the islands. Prior exposure to field techniques for bird capture, handling and collection of biological samples for disease screening. Familiarity with data analysis, including R programming and GIS tools. Proficiency in English and Hindi (speaking, reading, and writing). Experience with molecular biology techniques, including RNA/DNA isolation, NGS library preparation, and developing pipelines for various NGS applications. Experience with targeted RT-qPCR and NGS platforms. Expertise in analysing mid/or whole genome data types. Familiarity with wildlife population-level studies using molecular techniques. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to contribute in a team-based environment. Good written and oral communication skill. Interest in studying avian ecology and conservation; skill in field identification of birds. Prior experience in bird survey methods and sampling design. Willingness to reside in remote locations with challenging conditions and travel extensively by road and sea between the islands. Familiarity with basic data analysis and GIS tools. Proficiency in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and Hindi (speaking). Interest in studying avian ecology and conservation; skill in field identification of birds. Familiarity with bird survey methods and sampling design. Willingness to reside in remote locations with challenging conditions and travel extensively by road and sea between the islands. Familiarity with basic data analysis and GIS tools. Proficiency in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and Hindi (speaking). The upper age limit may be relaxed as per Government of India norms: up to 5 years for SC/ST candidates and up to 3 years for OBC candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each post is for one year (likely to be extended) on a purely temporary basis. Selected candidates will be provided hostel accommodation at SACON as per availability. Other allowances and benefits to the research personnel will be admissible as per the rules.

rows.post: Project Associate-II (Molecular Biology) (2(a)) and Project Associate-II (3(a))

content_sections.heading: SACON Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct species population surveys and ecological studies in remote areas of Andaman and Nicobar Islands with limited resources and challenging field conditions. Collect and analyze field data and contribute to preparation of reports. Assist with conducting social surveys among local communities to understand their views on species conservation. Work closely with the forest department and local communities to develop sustainable conservation/management plan. Assist the Project Investigator and senior project staff in achieving project goals and other institutional activities. Collect biological samples from birds following ethical guidelines and standard protocols. Undertake laboratory work and data analysis. Maintain lab diary and analytical records. Assist the PI in achieving project goals and other institutional activities. Conduct field studies on endemic and cavity-nesting birds in remote areas of Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Collect and analyze field data and assist in drafting project reports. Work closely with the forest department and local communities to develop sustainable conservation/management plan. Assist the Project Investigator and senior project staff in achieving project goals and other institutional activities. Conduct field studies on endemic and cavity-nesting birds in remote areas of Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Collect and analyze field data and contribute to preparation of project reports. Work closely with the forest department and local communities to develop sustainable conservation/management plan. Assist the Project Investigator and senior project staff in achieving project goals and other institutional activities.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SACON Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 positions: one Project Associate-I in Project 1, one Project Associate-II (Molecular Biology) in Project 2, and in Project 3 one Project Associate-II and two Project Associate-I.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 07 December 2026, up to 5:00 PM, through the online portal at https://wii-saconrp.in/.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: A Post-Graduate degree (M.Sc.) or equivalent with a minimum of 55% marks in life sciences or environmental sciences from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Associate-II?
faq.answer: The same M.Sc. with a minimum of 55% marks in the listed life sciences disciplines, plus two years of post-PG research experience in relevant scientific projects and activities.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 07-12-2026, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST and up to 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I gets Rs.37,000 + HRA (NET/GATE qualified) or Rs. 30,000 + HRA (non-NET/GATE). Project Associate-II gets Rs.42,000 + HRA or Rs. 33,000 + HRA respectively.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the monthly emoluments?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints each amount as "+ HRA". Hostel accommodation at SACON is provided as per availability, and other allowances are admissible as per the rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General candidates pay Rs. 500/-. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD candidates are exempted from this fee but pay Rs.100/- as Application Processing Fee. Both are non-refundable.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are invited for an Online Interview, through which final selection is made. Details are sent individually by email.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one position?
faq.answer: Yes, for a maximum of two positions, each with a separate application, separate supporting documents and the fee paid separately for each.
